Setup Overviews: Outbound
        Below are lists of the setup procedures required to use the outbound 
 functional areas. 
         
        NOTE: Actions without hyperlinks can be performed by your Manhattan Associates representative.
         
         
        Allocation 
        
            Review the 
 allocation strategies
            Define allocation location selection 
 records
            Define 
 allocation rule sets
            Associate 
 the rule sets with the correct items
            Assign 
 a permanent location to an item
            Define 
 an advanced allocation record
        
         
         
        Carrier Technical
        
            Review the system created check digit algorithms
            Define each carrier's pro numbers
            Review the system created carrier 
 types
            Identify NMFC codes
            Review the system's rating values
            Review the system's LTL classes
            Review the system created freight 
 terms
            Review the EDI reference records
        
         
         
        Container Creation in a Wave
        
            Review 
 container shape types
            Create the container groups
            Create packing criteria records
            Work with packing classes
            Define container creation criteria 
 records
            Review container creation system values
        
         
         
        Dock Management (Consolidation)
        
            Activate the consolidation putaway functionality
            Review dock location classes 
            Create consolidation location areas
            Create consolidation locations
            Define a carrier's default consolidation location area
        
         
         
        Dock Management (Staging / Loading)
        
            Activate staging/loading functionality
            Create packing/staging/dock door locations (in the Location Window)
            Associate a carrier group type to dock areas (on the Carrier Group Window) [optional - define if using "Select Dock Area Using Carrier" selection strategy]
            Create dock area carrier assignment records [optional - define if using "Select Dock Area Using Carrier" selection strategy]
            Define dock management flow records
            Define dock management work criteria records
            Define dock area anchor criteria records [optional - define if using "Anchor Dock Area Using Shipment" selection strategy]
            Define dock location anchor criteria values (on the Location Window) [optional - define if using "Anchor Dock Area Using Shipment" selection strategy
        
         
         
        Order Entry 
        
            Define order entry values
            Create customer categories
            Define order item selection records
            Define order ship to selection records
            Define shipment process types
            Review system values
        
         
         
        Outbound Quality Control
        
            Define outbound QC assignment criteria records
            Define outbound QC assignment records
            Define outbound QC-related packing preferences
            Define outbound QC reason codes
        
         
         
        Packing/Shipping 
        
            Define all necessary container classes
            Define all container types
            Define packing preferences
            If appropriate, identify regular customers that 
 you service
            Define shipping preferences
            Define the values two shipments 
 must share in order to consolidate
            Associate the packing and shipping 
 preferences with the appropriate users
            Define a freight consolidators
            Define intermediate 
 consignees
            Create store location assignment records
            Review delivery types
        
         
         
        Pallet UM Conversion
        
            Define pallet UM conversion criteria records
            Define wave master
        
        .
         
        Pallet Building In A Wave 
         
        Discussion:  Pallet Building Strategy - Nesting using pallet maximum height
        Prerequisite: Container Creation In A Wave setup
        
            Create a pallet container type
            Create pallet building criteria record
            Create a pallet building master record
            Choose a pallet building master on the appropriate wave master
        
         
         
        Progistics   
        
            Identify that Progistics 
 is installed
            Create each shipper's code
            Define a shipper cross-reference 
 record
            Identify the shipper in Progistics
        
         
         
        Rating 
        
            Create a rating profile for each 
 carrier
            Review the default rating IDs
            Review the default services
            Complete the required Routing setup 
 steps
            Define accessorials
            If appropriate,  define carrier 
 discounts in Progistics 
 CS
        
         
         
        Rating - LTL 
        
            Create a rating profile for each 
 carrier
            Review the default rating IDs
            Complete  the required Routing setup 
 steps
            Create a weight break 
            Create a rate base
            Create  additional criteria assignment - optional step
            Create  a carrier rate base assignment record
        
         
         
        Routing 
        
            Define 
 when the carrier cannot transport product (shipping calendar)
            Define 
 the carrier's record
            Define the carrier's postal code 
 range (carrier commitment)
            Create any necessary carrier groups
            Create a routing guide
        
         
         
        Status Technical 
        
            Review the default 
 status action values
            Review the default system status 
 names
        
         
         
        Status/Status Flow
        
            Review the system defined statuses 
 (Functional Area Window)
            Create all user defined statuses 
 (Functional Area Window)
            Review the default status flow
            If necessary, create custom  status flow
        
         
         
        UPS World Ease 
        
            Setup Prerequisites/Requirements
            
            Define intermediate 
 consignees
            UPS World Ease Setup Procedural Flow
            
        
         
         
        Value Added Services
        
            Define VAS activity criteria records
            
            Define VAS activities
            Define VAS-related packing preferences
            
        
         
         
        Wave Processing
        
            Review the wave statuses
            Define the wave steps into wave 
 flows
            Define the wave criteria rule sets
            Define wave maximum records
            Define wave master records
            Define planned shipment filters 
            Define how you want the system to 
 override shipment data in the wave
            Create Pro 
 and BOL number criteria
        
         
         
        Work Creation
        
            Create the work creation master
            Review the work creation process summary
            Define the work creation setup
            Define work criteria records
            Define work types creation
